props.Definition: Low iron stores, often from slow blood loss. Tiredness, pale skin, sometimes breathlessness.
Swollen veins in the lower rectum. Common, usually harmless, and the first thing blood in the stool gets blamed on.
Cramps and changing bowel habit with no visible cause. A diagnosis of exclusion.
